identity.summary: Local Companion introduces an owner-approved calm-orbit identity and distinct Full and Reduced masters. Existing approved brand geometry remains unchanged.

palette.summary: Local Companion adds an independent graphite and indigo palette plus app-matched warning, error, success, and information cues with measured dark and light contrast. Existing brand palettes remain unchanged.

typography.summary: The new kit bundles licensed local Space Grotesk, Geist, and Geist Mono faces. Existing kit typography remains authoritative.

platform_assets.summary: Generate Local Companion logo, icon, and social-image assets for its new public kit. The centered single-line social composition is opt-in; existing social assets remain unchanged.

web_react.summary: Local Companion gains four functional cue tokens in Web and React output; existing adapter APIs and outputs remain unchanged.

egui.summary: The egui adapter API remains unchanged and its Local Companion output references the measured color-role manifest. Existing adapter outputs remain unchanged.

wordpress.summary: WordPress adapter 1.0.0 retains its public contract and is generated for the new Local Companion kit.

documentation.summary: Add Local Companion hosted guidance, public facts, social metadata, and direct downloads while retaining all existing guideline routes.

recovery.summary: Existing kits have no required identity migration. Regenerate and repin exact 2.8.0 packages only to adopt its compiler; pin Local Companion 1.0.0 by its release archive and SHA-256.
